title: Gray Bow Knit & Black Boots
prompt: An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair stands in a full-length pose against a pale gray studio backdrop. She wears a gray ribbed knit top with an oversized tied bow at the neck and buttons down the side, layered over a black gathered mini skirt. Sheer gray tights and cream ribbed socks show above tall black lace-up combat boots. She holds a black structured handbag with a small red charm. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft diagonal studio light. Palette of gray, black, and cream. Refined and playful, in the style of a contemporary knitwear catalog.
workingNotes:
- The oversized tied bow and combat boots are the signature details.
- Add 'head to toe' to keep the boots in frame.
tryThis: Try this: Use head-to-toe framing to include the boots.
